title: Brand Token Override Schema
description: Schema for semantic and component-specific brand token overrides

components.description: Component overrides keyed by current PascalCase contract name, then the token suffix without repeating the component prefix. For example, components.CodeBlock.design.root.shape.radius addresses --fsds-code-block-design-root-shape-radius. Values must reach a consumed Web component token or design slot; generate:check rejects unknown and unconsumed destinations. The brand layer emits namespaced values at the brand scope for detached parts and on component roots to override local defaults. The Default brand also applies when data-brand is absent. Use top-level semantic groups for decisions shared across components. Consumer unlayered CSS or inline component overrides can supersede the brand.
